guitar.notes: Nile Rodgers' 1960 Fender Stratocaster nicknamed 'The Hitmaker' is iconic and extremely well documented, central to Chic's funk/disco guitar sound.

tone.target: clean Nile Rodgers funk chime with tight compression
tone.profile: clean Nile Rodgers funk chime with tight compression
tone.summary: A classic funk setup utilizing a clean Fender-style amp (Silver Twin) paired with heavy compression and bright EQ to emulate Nile Rodgers' signature chime.
